osm-health-facilities.title: OpenStreetMap mapped health facilities
osm-health-facilities.limitations: OpenStreetMap contributor coverage. Not an official Lagos State health facility registry. Presence, position and service level are unverified; some facilities may be missing, closed or duplicated.

osm-marine-access.title: OpenStreetMap mapped marine access points
osm-marine-access.limitations: Ferry terminals, piers and landing candidates tagged in OpenStreetMap. Not an official jetty register. Official status and navigability are unknown.

osm-waterways.title: OpenStreetMap mapped waterways
osm-waterways.limitations: waterway=* linework from OpenStreetMap. Navigability is not assessed — these lines must not be treated as a navigable transport network.
